class.name: NavigationTransitionRule3D
class.brief_description: Rules that extend a [NavigationRegion3D] bake with traversal surfaces.
class.description: Assign to [member NavigationRegion3D.transition_rules]. After the standard walking mesh is baked, [method _bake_surfaces] may append directed traversal surface polygons and describe them in [member NavigationMesh.traversal_surfaces].

method.name: _bake_surfaces
method.description: Extends the region's freshly baked walking mesh with traversal surfaces. Return [code]true[/code] to publish the result. In the editor, implement this method in a tool script.

method.name: _collect_source_geometry
method.description: Optionally adds geometry to the region's parsed bake input before generating the walking mesh.
